q: Why does the guide say keep the truth in your database?
o: Push is best-effort and can be late or lost
why: The app reads your backend on open; push only says look now.

q: Fraud alerts in a payments app should use push as …
o: a 'check the app' signal with no sensitive content
why: Auditable delivery lives in your backend.

q: What does choosing FCM commit you to?
o: A sender, a token table and Google as a transport
Google owning your data and logins
why: It is a leaf, so it is easy to remove.

q: Push alone is enough to carry live walkie-talkie audio.
why: Push only wakes the app; audio needs a socket or WebRTC.
